title: Grammar: Replace the item and keep the amount
subtitle: A2 · Unit 10: Food, shopping and quantities

steps.title: Replace the item and keep the amount
steps.body: When the food or item is already clear, en can replace a phrase with de or a quantity phrase. Keep the amount after the verb when the amount matters: des pommes → j'en prends; un kilo de pommes → j'en prends un kilo.

steps.title: Read each quantity and its unit together. This helps you understand the amount before you replace the food with en.
rows: Je prends deux barquettes de fraises.
I am taking two punnets of strawberries.
Nous gardons la moitié pour demain.
We are keeping half for tomorrow.
I am reheating the prepared dish.

steps.title: Place en before the verb it belongs to. With aller + infinitive, put it before the infinitive: je vais en acheter. Keep a useful amount or number after the verb.
rows: The item is clear from context.
The item is clear from context.
Je prends une barquette de fraises.
Je vais acheter un kilo de tomates.
Je vais en acheter un kilo.
The amount stays after the infinitive.
The amount stays after the verb.
Je ne prends pas de lentilles.
In the negative, ne comes before en.

steps.title: Replace the item and keep the amount
steps.body:
• Use en to avoid repeating a thing introduced with de, du, de la, des, or a quantity phrase: des fraises → j'en prends.
• Keep the quantity when it carries information: un kilo → j'en prends un kilo; quatre → j'en prends quatre.
• Put en before the verb: j'en veux; il en reste. With aller + infinitive, put it before the infinitive: je vais en prendre.
• In a simple negative, use ne + en + verb + pas: je n'en prends pas.
• Here, practise en with food and quantities. Other uses of en exist; do not infer every one from these examples.
• Write one sentence about an amount you buy, underline what en replaces, and retrieve it later without looking.

steps.prompt: Tu achètes des fraises ? Oui, j'___ achète.
Je prends une barquette de fraises. Je ___ prends une barquette.
steps.explain: En replaces de fraises; the package quantity une barquette stays.

steps.prompt: Choose the correct near-future form for 'I will buy one kilogram of tomatoes.'
options: Je vais en acheter un kilo.
Je vais acheter en un kilo.
Je vais un kilo en acheter.
steps.explain: With aller + infinitive, put en before the infinitive and keep the quantity after it.

steps.prompt: Choose the correct negative sentence for 'I am not taking any lentils.'
steps.explain: The pattern is ne + en + verb + pas.
